scope: One complete connected aboveground surface assembly at the western of the three northern anonymous shaft points. Nearby separate buildings, other shafts and unrelated plant equipment remain separate.
appearanceSources: Existing published Qualla NASA ISS038-E-29810 first
observation: Both existing originals show a compact multi-part surface assembly with dark horizontal projections, pale box-like masses and rounded patches on its eastern side. It differs from the taller northern east shaft form. Road bends and the relative three-point arrangement support a broad region-to-point association, not surveyed registration.
chosenBody: Complete estimated connected surface plant: central box-like collar housing, taller northern box housing, western low equipment housing, horizontal connecting galleries/plenums and two eastern rounded process housings on individual foundations with estimated access equipment. Rounded housings have opaque tops; no exposed fan blades or functional machinery identity claimed.
